title: Lighthouse a11y 91: contrast and touch-target audits fail; issues badge 1
fix_note: Question-log page (the audited surface; the components/cognition panels are unmounted at branch state): small print in text-zinc-500 on near-black (approx 4.17:1) bumped to zinc-400 (approx 7.4:1) at the loading status, empty-state explainer, 'Still open.' line and entities explainer; trace action-row buttons (Edit/Reopen/Mark answered/Delete/Keep/Save/Cancel) and the error Retry given min-h-[40px] inline-flex targets. The ticket's root_cause guess (RCA-contrast-theme-tokens lattice flip) is refined by recon: the failing pairs are this page's own hard-coded zinc palette, not lattice utilities. The 1 DevTools issue is not identifiable from code; plausibly the same contrast class. Pins: tests/a11y-bundle-remainder.test.tsx; negative control 16/16 fail on pristine.

title: [RCA-contrast-theme-tokens] Lighthouse 99/92/96/100: contrast and touch-target failures; 1 DevTools issue
actual: Fails: insufficient contrast, touch targets too small; ARIA role warning; Issues panel 1
fix_note: ARIA leg: DxWorkbench tab pattern completed to the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern - each tab gains id + aria-controls, and each tab's content is wrapped in role=tabpanel with aria-labelledby pointing back at its tab. Touch targets: tab buttons given min-h-[40px]. Contrast leg VERIFY-ONLY: attributed to RCA-contrast-theme-tokens; the lens's text is zinc-scale on the frame's fixed dark chrome and its visible pairs pass AA by computation, so no lens-local contrast change. The 1 DevTools issue is not identifiable from code; plausibly the incomplete tab pattern. Rider: dx-platform is platform-adjacent, worked under the dx-platform-008 precedent per claim CB-0459. Pins: tests/a11y-bundle-remainder.test.tsx.

title: No sort on any Records tab; Livestock/Equipment/Water/Harvest/Cert filters list crop statuses
close_rule: Closes only after live re-run of original repro + nearby smoke on affected lens
fix_note: Sort leg FIXED: RecordsPanel (the one panel behind every agriculture Records tab) gains a labelled sort select (Default order / Newest / Oldest / Name A-Z / Name Z-A) applied client-side to the useLensData items the panel already holds; the status filter also gains its missing aria-label. Filter-options leg NAMED, not fixed: the filter lists the crop Status vocabulary, but that vocabulary IS the data model for every record kind - the create/edit form's own status select offers the identical list for livestock, equipment, water, harvest and cert records, and badges render from the same STATUS_CONFIG; per-kind status vocabularies are a data-model/product change, not a find control, and stay open for their own claim (legal-009 scoping shape). Pins: tests/find-controls.test.tsx (11-suite file), fail on pristine.

title: No control to clear observer location once set
repro_steps: Sky Chart > set location > look for clear/reset
expected: Clear / reset location control returning to empty/compute-required state
actual: Location can be overwritten (restored to 40.7128/-74.0060) but no dedicated clear control
fix_note: SkyChartWorkbench gains a Clear location button beside the observer readout (rendered while an observer is set): clears the observer state, blanks the lat/lon inputs, clears any geolocation error, and removes the persisted 'astronomy:observer' localStorage copy, so the location stays cleared across reloads; the workbench returns to its set-your-location state. Pins: tests/find-controls-2.test.tsx, fail on pristine.
